blocks.text: Numbers 30 contains 16 verses. It opens with: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded. It concludes with: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The final third of Numbers prepares the new generation for land inheritance through a second census, inheritance rulings, Joshua's commission, land boundaries, towns, and tribal safeguards.
